title: Australia has 2.74 million small businesses
hook: Australia has 2,741,087 small businesses. Most of their news never gets a run. 🤔
cta: Tag a small business owner whose story deserves coverage

slides.label: actively trading *small businesses*
slides.body: That's **97%** of all businesses (30 June 2026). Plenty of stories. Not much airtime.

captions_meta.hook: Australia has 2,741,087 small businesses. Most of their news never gets a run. 🤔
lines: From the Australian Small Business and Family Enterprise Ombudsman:
A new site, a first export deal, 20 new hires: genuinely newsworthy.
Usually just not written up in a way a newsroom can use.
captions_meta.li_hook:
There were 2,741,087 actively trading small businesses in Australia at 30 June 2026, 97% of all businesses.
Their share of business coverage is a fraction of that.
li_body: ASBFEO's figures are mostly used in policy debates. We see a communications gap: millions of businesses with milestones that never reach a journalist.

Not because they lack news value, but because they aren't packaged as news. A second location, a first export contract or a hiring round is a solid local story when it comes with clear numbers and a spokesperson who will take a call.
captions_meta.li_close: If you run a small business: what from this year deserved a story?
captions_meta.fb: Fun fact: Australia has more than 2.7 million small businesses. If yours is one of them, your news deserves a run too.
